title: 最高分是幾號
question:
請輸入 1 號到 5 號同學的成績存進清單，輸出最高分的是幾號。如果最高分的人不只一個，輸出號碼最小的那位。
提示：用一個變數記住「目前最高分是幾號」，一個一個跟 成績[i] 比。

test_case.note: 4 號和 5 號都是 88 分，輸出號碼小的 4

en.title: Who Is the Top?
en.question:
Input the scores of student 1 to student 5 into a list. Output the number of the student with the top score. If two students have the top score, output the smaller number.
Tip: Make a variable for "the top student so far". Check each score[i] one by one.

test_case.note: The top score is 95. It is student 2
The top score is the first one
Student 4 and 5 both have 88. Output the smaller number, 4
